title: Growth Account Executive (US market | SaaS | B2B)
description:
About SleekFlow

Join SleekFlow, a thriving SaaS startup that is experiencing rapid growth globally thanks to the support of renowned investors like Alibaba Entrepreneurs Fund and Tiger Global. Our mission is to develop the next generation of Conversational AI, empowering customer interactions across all channels—from messaging to voice—and enhancing business workflows and processes.

You will have the opportunity to thrive alongside the company through equity options. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and assume a larger role, we look forward to meeting you!

At SleekFlow, we have developed an all-in-one Omnichannel Conversation AI Suite that drives conversions through conversations. Our platform seamlessly integrates with popular channels such as WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, WeChat, and more, providing comprehensive communication solutions. With our AI customer engagement platform, enterprises can automate growth by enhancing productivity across their sales, marketing, and support teams.

As we expand into the US market, we’re on the lookout for adventurous, diverse, and passionate Brazilian talents to join us on this exciting journey. Become a part of our team and take your career to new heights with SleekFlow!

Associate Level

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Prior Experience in SaaS/ Software Industry is preferred

Language: Business-level fluency in English

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the US market expansion, develop client relationships, and driving US sales growth
  • Actively manage the sales process, including positioning, presentation/demonstration of product, and closing warm leads generated by marketing and sales development
  • Full sales cycle rep, actively managing the sales process, including positioning, presentation/demonstration of product, and closing
  • Managing complex sales cycles and presenting to C-level executives the value of SleekFlow's software
  • A Hunter mindset - the role would require you to be resourceful when coming up with your territory plan, sourcing for leads & opportunities and being able to generate enough curiosity to land the crucial first meetings with the target Accounts.
  • Forecast sales activity and revenue achievement while creating satisfied and reference-able customers
  • Demonstrating our product via video conferencing
  • Stay abreast of the latest trends in internet technology and eCommerce

Qualifications

  • Business-level fluency in English is a must (American accent preferred) & Portuguese, Spanish will be a plus
  • Degree in Business or a related field (preferred with USA background)
  • Experience carrying a quota and closing deals in software (business applications preferred) or technology sales
  • Consistently over-achieved quota (top 5-10% of the company) in past positions
  • High level of initiative and self-motivation. Attention to detail and strong communication skills
  • Proven ability to work well within a team environment while accomplishing individual tasks
  • High level of curiosity and empathy with the ability to understand a potential customer's context, issues and pain points through effective questioning and listening
  • Excellent attention to detail with a good understanding of the sales cycle and the importance of accurate pipelining and forecast reporting
  • CRM (e.g. Hubspot) & marketing experience preferred
  • Strong customer references
  • Strong computer skills, including CRM, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate.

SleekFlow is a place where everyone can grow. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Senior Backend Engineer is a crucial position within Vingcard | ASSA ABLOY, primarily responsible for designing, developing and maintaining robust backend solutions that power our innovative access control systems for hotels and adjacent markets. The role demands a deep understanding of backend technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin. The candidate will work in a dynamic, cross-functional team to deliver high-quality software that enhances the functionality and performance of our products.

  • Job Location: Brasilia, Brazil

KEY Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain backend applications using Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Java, and Kotlin.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate user-facing elements using server-side logic.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle, from design to deployment.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize backend systems.
  • Ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current backend technologies and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews, providing feedback and suggestions for improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior developers, helping them navigate technical challenges and grow in their careers.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, including code quality, testing, and documentation.

Responsibilities And Authorities

  • Authority to make technical decisions related to software architecture and design.
  • Access to all necessary information and tools to perform role effectively.
  • Responsibility for delivering high-quality software solutions on time and within budget.
  • Authority to mentor and provide career development support to junior developers.
  • Reporting to the R&D Manager for project assignments and career development.

Internal and External Contacts/Customers

  • Internal: Work closely with other software developers, QA engineers, product managers, and designers.
  • External: Interact with external stakeholders during product demos or user feedback sessions.

Skills

Key competencies, Relevant Knowledge, skills and competEncies

  • Proficient in Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Experience with observability technologies (e.g. Datadog).
  • Experience with Git versioning systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development.
  • Proven experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Familiarity with Git versioning systems.

Languages

  • Proficiency in English for listening, reading and writing. Intermediate speaking skills in English. Proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese.

Computer Skills

  • Proficiency in software development tools, version control systems (e.g., Git), and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment pipelines.
  • Proficiency in Java/Kotlin.
  • Deep knowledge of Spring MVC and/or Spring Boot.
  • Proficiency in interacting with relational databases.
  • Working knowledge of distributed architectures and messaging systems (RabbitMQ, AMQP, etc).
  • Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes, etc).

Experience

  • Software Engineer, Backend Engineer or similar position.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience.

Personal qualities

  • Strong leadership and mentorship skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with a drive to take initiative and lead projects.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with a commitment to staying up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies.
  • Adaptable and eager to learn new technologies and practices.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on code quality and best practices.

Expected outcome and deliverables -(For the role, on a 3-5 years horizon)

Over the next 3-5 years, the Senior Backend Engineer will contribute significantly to the development and optimization of our backend systems, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and efficient. The role will play a key part in enhancing the functionality of our access control solutions, delivering high-quality software that meets the needs of our customers and stays ahead of industry trends, including launching new products. The individual in this position will have the opportunity to grow professionally, acquiring new skills and taking on additional responsibilities as part of a dynamic and innovative team.

Vingcard Athos Team

The Vingcard Athos team, based in Brasília, Brazil, specializes in developing innovative solutions for the Build-to-Rent market, catering to both long and short-term rentals of furnished apartments. As a small and dynamic team, we manage the entire solution, including IoT devices, backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

We operate on a hybrid work model, with three days in the office and two days working from home. While our primary language of communication is Portuguese, all our code and documentation are in English, and meetings involving other teams are conducted in English.

Our team is an integral part of the Vingcard Research & Development organization headquartered in Sweden. We are thrilled to have you join us!

CONTRACT DETAILS

  • You will be a registered employee (CLT) of ASSA ABLOY GLOBAL SOLUTIONS IMPORTACAO EXPORTACAO DE EQUIPAMENTOS ELETRONICOS LTDA.
  • Benefits include Vale Refeição.
  • Benefits include health insurance (plano de saúde) for you, your spouse and your children at no additional cost.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 61,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence
description:

O desafio envolve combinar visão analítica, domínio técnico e mentalidade experimental para desenvolver soluções escaláveis e com alto impacto, sempre com uma abordagem data-driven, colaborativa e voltada a resultados.

  • Selecionar tecnologias (LLMs, pipelines de dados, Power BI, Looker Studio) e integrá-las às plataformas de marketing, comunicação, vendas e processos de gestão estratégica;
  • Desenvolver frameworks analíticos que priorizem oportunidades de mercado, melhorem o score de leads e apoiem decisões de pricing e go-to-market;
  • Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
  • Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
  • Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
  • Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.

Requisitos e Perfil:

  • Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;

Diferenciais:

  • Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou SaaS B2B.

Sobre a UPX:

Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.

Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Departamento Pessoal

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: On-Site IT Support Engineer
description:
Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.

Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.

Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.

Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.

Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.

Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.

Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.

Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.

Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.

Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.

Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.

Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.

Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.

Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.

Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

title: Repórter - Tribunais Superiores
description:
Sobre o Bastidor

Somos um veículo criado em 2020 por Diego Escosteguy com a missão de iluminar os segredos do poder. Nossa matéria-prima são notícias exclusivas e de alto impacto, seja por meio de informações sintéticas, seja por meio de reportagens profundas. Cobrimos assuntos e casos difíceis, que envolvem grandes personagens da vida política e econômica nacional. Praticamos jornalismo independente e apartidário com rigor profissional, mediante investigação crítica de fatos de interesse público.

Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, apuração constante junto a fontes humanas e uso avançado de ferramentas digitais e de IA para obtenção, checagem e análise de fontes documentais.

Sobre a vaga

Procuramos um repórter para cobrir, in loco, os tribunais superiores em Brasília, sobretudo Supremo Tribunal Federal e Superior Tribunal de Justiça. Experiência é desejável, mas não é o mais importante; buscamos talentos que tenham disposição para aprender e vontade de se tornar um grande repórter. Nossa cobertura de STF e STJ envolve tanto movimentos de bastidor e articulações por nomeações no Judiciário quanto acompanhamento de processos relevantes - sempre sob a supervisão de nossos editores.

Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar pautas (plenário/turmas), ler petições, votos, ementas e acórdãos.
  • Acompanhar liminares, pedidos de vista e movimentação processual (PJe, jurisprudência).
  • Mapear litigância estratégica de empresas, políticos e setores.
  • Construir e manter fontes (gabinetes, advocacia, PGR/AGU, academia, sociedade civil) com ética.
  • Produzir reportagens explicativas e investigativas com documentação sólida.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com editores e colegas para desenvolver pautas próprias e séries investigativas.
  • Usar ferramentas digitais/IA para triagem, verificação e organização de materiais.

Requisitos (obrigatórios)

  • Graduação em Jornalismo (concluída).
  • Domínio da Língua Portuguesa (clareza, lógica, gramática e edição).
  • Técnicas básicas de apuração; leitura cuidadosa de documentos jurídicos.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de STF e STJ (pautas, ritos, institutos).
  • Predisposição para construir e preservar fontes com ética e responsabilidade.
  • Independência e apartidarismo; julgamento editorial equilibrado.
  • Espírito crítico, curiosidade intelectual, trabalho em equipe e abertura a feedback.
  • Conforto com planilhas e pesquisa em bases públicas; disposição para aprender IA.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Formação/experiência em Direito ou cobertura de tribunais superiores.
  • Noções de pesquisa jurisprudencial e leitura de dados de litigância.
  • Inglês de leitura.

O que você aprenderá no Bastidor

  • Técnicas avançadas de reportagem e produção de exclusivas de alto impacto.
  • Pesquisa e obtenção de evidências jornalisticamente úteis (bases públicas e privadas).
  • Análise empírica e lógica de evidências e valoração criteriosa de fatos (epistemologia aplicada ao jornalismo).
  • Redação assertiva, equilibrada e clara, sem clichês, ilações ou hipérboles.
  • Uso avançado de IA e ML para organização, pesquisa e análise de casos.
  • Segurança operacional (física e digital) e proteção de fontes e documentos.

Como se candidatar

Envie seu currículo para com "Repórter Tribunais Superiores" e seu nome no campo de assunto. Inclua links para até três reportagens de sua autoria e um texto de até 300 palavras que descreva por que você quer trabalhar conosco.

description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.

O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade

Na posição de Analista de Custos Sênior você será responsável pelo fechamento, acompanhamento, controle e execução das atividades de planejamento e análise de custos e despesas das Fabricas e Centros de Distribuição, contribuindo para o atingimento das metas de resultados, dentro dos prazos, padrões de qualidade e ao menor custo possível, através de adequada alocação de seus recursos humanos, técnicos e materiais.

Responsabilidades

  • Analisar os processos de rateio de custos nos Centros de Distribuição por meio da verificação de possíveis distorções, propondo ajustes e adequações;
  • Garantir que as quantidades e valores contidas nos estoques estejam coerentes e de acordo com as movimentações diárias;
  • Garantir a alocação correta dos gastos em contas contábeis e centros de custo, através do acompanhamento das despesas de todas as áreas e Centros de Distribuição do grupo;
  • Apoio a área de Contabilidade nas entregas legais de ECF (escrituração contábil e fiscal) e Transfer Price (percentual de malte constante nos produtos acabados), conciliando e confeccionando relatórios suporte;
  • Assegurar o correto fechamento do custo contábil do mix de produtos, mediante a análise da produção do período, das despesas indiretas e das variações dos fatores que impactam diretamente (matéria prima, insumos, mão de obra, materiais, embalagem, gastos com transformação), de forma a obter valorização do estoque e da produção;

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Senior Cloud Data Engineer
description:
RESUMES IN ENGLISH PLEASE

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Cloud Data Engineer leads the design, architecture, and implementation of secure, scalable data solutions on AWS, utilizing Snowflake, dbt, and modern automation tools. This role drives best practices for data quality, validation, and governance, while optimizing performance and reliability across both cloud and legacy platforms. The Senior Cloud Data Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines and products, mentor junior engineers, and champions continuous improvement in engineering standards and operational excellence.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads the design, development, and maintenance of highly scalable, secure, and resilient data pipelines and systems on cloud platforms.
  • Architects and implements advanced data integration solutions to support complex analytics, business intelligence, and enterprise reporting needs.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, business analysts, product owners, and application engineers—to understand and deliver on evolving data requirements.
  • Ensures the highest standards of data quality, integrity, and security through comprehensive testing, validation, and robust governance practices.
  • Monitors, optimizes, and scales data workflows to achieve performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency targets across both cloud and legacy environments.
  • Proactively identifies, investigates, and resolves data-related issues, providing technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior team members.
  • Champions continuous improvement by staying current with industry trends, emerging technologies, best practices, and by driving innovation in data engineering processes and solutions.
  • Partners with enterprise architecture and data governance teams to define and enforce data standards and compliance requirements.
  • Leads design reviews and technical workshops to uplevel engineering practices across the organization.
  • Contributes to strategic planning for data platform evolution and modernization initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE: Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or other related field of study; or any combination of relevant work experience and education

EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in data engineering, with a strong emphasis on designing and implementing cloud-based solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, with hands-on experience in both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
  • Extensive experience architecting and operating data platforms on AWS and Azure; relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer Associate) strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling, and enterprise data governance frameworks.
  • Demonstrated success in leading and mentoring data engineering teams, driving technical excellence and fostering collaborative environments.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and proactively in fast-paced settings.
  • Outstanding communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration abilities, with a proven track record of partnering with business and technical stakeholders.

COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Cloud Platform (AWS): Extensive hands-on experience architecting and operating data solutions on AWS; relevant AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, AWS Solutions Architect) strongly preferred.
  • Data Warehousing: Deep expertise in data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and enterprise data governance, with a focus on AWS-native and integrated solutions.
  • Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python and Bash for automation, orchestration, and data processing tasks within AWS environments.
  • Data Integration: Proven ability to design and implement advanced data integration solutions supporting complex analytics and business intelligence requirements on AWS.
  • Database Management: Strong experience with both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB) databases, including AWS-native database services.
  • Data Quality & Security: Demonstrated commitment to maintaining high data quality, integrity, and security in AWS cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Tools & Technologies: Expertise with Snowflake, dbt, GitHub, Control-M, and familiarity with modern data engineering frameworks (e.g., Airflow, Fivetran, Matillion) as deployed on AWS.
  • Infrastructure: Solid understanding of both traditional on-premises (virtual/physical) and AWS cloud-based infrastructure, including Windows and Linux environments.
  • Open Source & AWS Services: Working knowledge of a variety of open-source tools and AWS services for data engineering, automation, and orchestration.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Proven track record of leading design efforts, mentoring engineers, and fostering technical excellence within teams.
  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaboration: Outstanding communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration abilities, partnering effectively with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Continuous Improvement: Commitment to staying current with AWS advancements, industry trends, and driving innovation in data engineering practices.

title: Social Media
description:
VAGA: SOCIAL MEDIA — CLÍNICA RIGATTI

Na Rigatti®, cada peça de conteúdo é mais do que “um post”: é um ponto de virada. Nossa visão é simples e ambiciosa — construir uma marca que transforma vidas com ética, ciência e beleza. Falamos com mulheres entre 34 e 55 anos, vaidosas, determinadas, que não aceitam mais viver abaixo do próprio potencial. O que publicamos precisa tocar mente, corpo e autoestima — com informação séria, estética premium e uma narrativa que convida à ação. “Desperte sua força real” não é um slogan; é um compromisso.

Nossa necessidade imediata é trazer para o time uma mente estratégica com mão na massa. Alguém que entenda jornada, dor, desejo e timing; que traduza conhecimento de saúde, emagrecimento e equilíbrio hormonal em conteúdo claro e desejável; que orquestre Instagram, TikTok e Facebook com consistência e padrão de excelência. Você vai pensar calendário, conduzir execução, garantir a coerência visual e verbal, e medir sempre medir para ajustar o rumo com precisão. É jogo de alta performance: copy que abre portas, vídeo curto com retenção, carrossel que educa sem ser pedante, stories que criam relação, CTA que move.

No dia a dia, você vai planejar, criar e agendar posts, Reels, stories e vídeos curtos; escrever legendas que unem storytelling e conversão; e sustentar os pilares da marca — transformação real, luxo, acolhimento e empoderamento em cada detalhe. Vai monitorar alcance, engajamento, salvamentos e compartilhamentos; interpretar métricas com olhar analítico e propor melhorias de rota. Vai interagir com a comunidade de forma inteligente, fortalecer as conversas nos comentários e directs e apoiar campanhas integradas com tráfego pago e remarketing, garantindo a costura fina entre conteúdo, performance e CRM.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

- Planejar, criar e agendar conteúdos (posts, reels, stories e vídeos curtos).

- Redigir legendas, chamadas e conteúdos educativos com foco em autoridade, engajamento e conversão.

- Criar conteúdos alinhados aos pilares da marca (transformação real, luxo, acolhimento e empoderamento).

- Monitorar métricas de engajamento, alcance, salvamentos e compartilhamentos.

- Interagir com a audiência nos comentários e directs de forma estratégica.

- Apoiar na construção de campanhas integradas com tráfego pago e remarketing.

DETALHES DA VAGA:

- Modelo: Presencial – Balneário Camboriú/SC

- Horário: Segunda a Sexta-feira, das 9h às 19h (2h de almoço)

- Salário fixo: R$ 6.000,00 (de acordo com experiência)

QUEM SOMOS

A RIGATTI® é uma clínica de transformação real. Somos referência em emagrecimento e equilíbrio hormonal com experiência de luxo, tratamentos personalizados e comunicação humanizada. Acreditamos no poder da mente, corpo e alma em equilíbrio e nosso conteúdo precisa refletir isso.

description:

title: Desenvolvedor .Net
description:
Exadel está em busca de um desenvolvedor de .Net para atuar deforma híbrida na região de faria lima 2 vezes na semana. Contratação CLT e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado.

O profissional trabalhará em projetos de "full acquiring", o que significa o desenvolvimento de sistemas que cobrem todas as etapas necessárias para a operação de um serviço de aquisição. Isso inclui tudo, desde a infraestrutura de processamento de pagamentos até a interface do cliente e gerenciamento de riscos.

  • Desenvolver e manter serviços back-end em .NET (Core e/ou Framework), focando em alto desempenho, escalabilidade e segurança.
  • Implementar integrações com APIs de adquirentes, gateways de pagamento, bandeiras de cartão e processadores.
  • Criar módulos de reconciliação financeira e de transações, tanto no front-end (captura e processamento) quanto no back-end (liquidação e compensação).
  • Garantir a integridade dos dados e a consistência das transações ao longo do fluxo de aquisição.
  • Colaborar com equipes de produto, QA e infraestrutura para entregar soluções robustas alinhadas com requisitos regulatórios e de negócios.
  • Participar de revisões de código, definição de arquitetura e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

*Requisitos Técnicos* Experiência em desenvolvimento back-end com C# e .NET Core ou .NET Framework. Experiência com Padrões de Design. Experiência com metodologias ágeis. Experiência com arquitetura Serverless. Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Kafka, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, RabbitMQ). Conhecimento em arquitetura de Microserviços. Conhecimento em APIs REST e ferramentas de controle de versão (Git). Conhecimento em Cloud (preferencialmente AWS). Experiência com bancos de dados NoSQL e/ou SQL (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB). Conhecimento em containerização (Docker e/ou Kubernetes) e pipelines de CI/CD.

*

*Conhecimento preferencial das regulamentações: Compreensão das regulamentações específicas da indústria de pagamentos, como PCI DSS (Padrão de Segurança de Dados da Indústria de Cartões de Pagamento).

title: Gerente de Contabilidade e Custos
description:

Temos muito orgulho de estar neste solo, trabalhando constantemente para manter nossa agricultura entre as maiores do planeta.

Somos a IHARA porque assim escolhemos ser! Sonhamos grande. Acreditamos que a capacidade humana é ilimitada e nos desafiamos sempre.

  • Definir KPIs e SLAs de cada atividade/área.

  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente - indispensável.
  • CRC Ativo.
  • Acima de 5 anos de experiência na área.

P RINCIPAIS BENEFÍCIOS:

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development

Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).

Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.

Location: Brazil

The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.

The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.

Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Lead Accountant (Brazil) - SQM Iodine & Plant Nutrition
description:
SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition , a global mining and chemical company, has a worldwide leadership position in the markets in which we are present, which is possible thanks to the strategic location of our operations in northern Chile, from where we have access to high-value resources, in addition to our network of commercial offices that allows us to reach more than 100 countries with our products.

Every day we are inspired by our purpose: “we develop unique capabilities that transform resources into life and progress” , achieving the highest quality products that generate value to strategic industries such as health, technology and food.

This is a great opportunity for talented people who can develop as a Accounting Lead for our office in Campinas, Brazil.

YOUR MISSION

Oversee and coordinate the company's administrative and financial activities, ensuring the efficient use of resources, compliance with accounting, tax, and legal obligations, and the generation of reliable information for decision-making. The objective is to guarantee financial stability, operational efficiency, and adequate support for other areas of the organization.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Bank Management

  • Receive, review, and process invoice payments.
  • Monitor cash balances based on the Company's cash flow needs.
  • Prepare bank reconciliations.

Third-Party Management

  • Keep customer and supplier master data up to date.
  • Request third-party assessments through the Compliance platform.

Credit and Commercial Control

  • Review and release customer orders in accordance with commercial risk policies.
  • Request credit line approvals from the insurer and internal managers, depending on the amount of exposure.
  • Request credit line extensions from the insurer when necessary.
  • Control and monitor customer credit lines.

Inventory Management

  • Perform the monthly closing of the inventory module.
  • Participate in the physical inventory control committees (quarterly).
  • Record adjustments resulting from physical inventory counts (when applicable).

Fixed Assets and Leases (IFRS 16)

  • Control recorded fixed assets.
  • Manage and monitor lease agreements in accordance with IFRS 16.
  • Review monthly depreciation of fixed assets and leases.

Payroll Management

  • Calculate sales commissions payable to the sales department.
  • Review payroll processed by the accounting outsourcing company.
  • Review monthly balances to be accounted for related to health, parafiscal contributions, and social benefits.

General Accounting

  • Provide support for the proper recording of accounting transactions.
  • Validate exchange rate controls on a quarterly basis.
  • Coordinate the closing and opening of accounting periods.
  • Manage accounting structures and taxes.
  • Send the monthly closing schedule to the relevant areas.

Other Routine Activities

  • Respond to and follow up on requests from the Statutory Auditor and external advisors.
  • Respond to requests from Corporate Audit.
  • Monitor and follow up on internal control.
  • Provide administrative support in response to requests from other areas, the Finance Manager, or other corporate management.
  • Analyze and communicate transfer pricing adjustments, when applicable.
  • Request supplier approvals in accordance with compliance criteria.
  • Manage expense reports on the Rydoo platform.
  • Prepare employment certificates.
  • Fill out forms for supplier registration.
  • Follow up on requirements from control entities.
  • Attend to legal procedures that apply to the company.

THE SKILLS YOU’LL NEED

  • Graduate in Accounting (Accounting Sciences) – qualification recognized in Brazil (active CRC)
  • Desirable Postgraduate degree in Finance, Taxation, or International Standards (IFRS)
  • Minimum 5 years in accounting roles (general accounting, taxes, financial reporting), preferably in medium or large companies.
  • Languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish.
  • Brazilian accounting (local standards), taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL), accounting reconciliations, tax compliance, reporting to the Federal Revenue Service.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel
  • Desirable use of Odoo
  • Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax and accounting legislation: IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS
  • Brazilian accounting standards (CPCs), IFRS, internal accounting closing and reconciliation procedures
  • Active registration with the CRC (Regional Accounting Council); IFRS course or tax MBA desirable.

WE OFFER:

  • Permanent hiring
  • Working day: Monday to Friday
  • Place of work: Initially, it will be remote work, followed by office work in Campinas, Brazil
  • The opportunity to belong and develop in a dynamic work environment and continuous learning

At SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition we are committed to the Inclusion Law (Law N°21.015) , so we invite you to inform us if you require any adjustment to properly participate in our selection processes.

title: Senior Data & Insight Manager
description:
About Keeta:

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world, Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

To know more: Keeta Website

Job Responsabilities

Root Cause Analysis & Strategic Diagnosis

  • Investigate complex business problems through structured root cause analysis.
  • Identify performance gaps across operations, product, and user experience, proposing data-driven solutions.
  • Develop diagnostic frameworks to continuously monitor and improve business health.

KPI Design & Operational Efficiency

  • Define and track key performance indicators focused on operational efficiency and business scalability.
  • Build dashboards and reports that provide visibility into process bottlenecks, cost drivers, and performance trends.
  • Collaborate with operations and product teams to implement improvements based on data insights.

User Growth & Behavioral Analytics

  • Analyze user acquisition, retention, and engagement metrics to identify growth opportunities.
  • Segment user behavior to uncover patterns that inform product strategy and marketing initiatives.
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation to validate hypotheses and optimize conversion funnels.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Influence

  • Partner with product, marketing, operations, and leadership teams to align on priorities and drive execution.
  • Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Act as a strategic advisor, using data to influence decision-making across the organization.

Job Requirements

Hard Skills

  • Advanced SQL proficiency for querying large datasets and building scalable data solutions.
  • Strong analytical toolkit: Excel, Python or R, Tableau or Power BI.
  • Experience with experimentation frameworks, cohort analysis, and funnel optimization.
  • Familiarity with data modeling and business intelligence best practices.

Soft Skills

  • Structured problem-solving and strategic thinking.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) to work with international teams
  • Ability to simplify complex data into clear narratives and recommendations.
  • High ownership, adaptability, and bias for action in fast-paced environments.
  • Curiosity and drive to understand user behavior and business dynamics.

Location: 100% On site - Vila Olimpia, SP

title: Coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Vendas - Belo Horizonte (MG)
description:
Resumo da Posição:

Liderar o crescimento do canal de Distribuidores, estabelecendo e fortalecendo parcerias com distribuidores da Royal Prestige e apoiando os territórios em seu desenvolvimento e crescimento sustentável da rede. O Coordenador de Desenvolvimento de Vendas é responsável por desenhar e executar o funil do distribuidor (recrutamento, seleção, integração, ativação), implementar segmentações e planos de negócios, e otimizar promoções de produtos e serviços por meio de relatórios disciplinados e análises. Este cargo promove a rápida adoção de novas formas de trabalho, coordena treinamentos e educação em campo, e apoia contratações para ampliar a capacidade. Os resultados esperados incluem aceleração na aquisição de novos clientes, maior conversão nas etapas do funil, aumento no volume de compras e vendas, melhor desempenho de produtos e expansão da cobertura de mercado nos territórios atribuídos.

Localização : Belo Horizonte - (MG) - modelo 100% campo

Responsabilidades:

  1. Apresentar e executar oportunidades (canal, geografia, produto, desempenho, atendimento ao cliente, iniciativas-chave, preço, etc.) utilizando todos os dados disponíveis. Construir e compartilhar o plano completo para recrutamento e aquisição de novos clientes.
  2. Construir e manter relações sólidas por meio de liderança com nossos Distribuidores Chave (Elite, Premier, Royal, Blue, etc.) e stakeholders internos para executar iniciativas estratégicas. Realizar reuniões periódicas para revisão de negócios dos territórios. Fornecer orientação aos escritórios regionais implementando planos de ação personalizados para cada rede.
  3. Ser um membro ativo em campo, ouvindo oportunidades de melhoria.
  4. Participar ativamente de atividades de prospecção, como feiras, estandes promocionais e eventos de recrutamento para apoiar a expansão da rede.
  5. Coordenar treinamentos essenciais para o distribuidor: vendas (geração de leads, processo de vendas, recrutamento, etc.), finanças, produto, serviço, compliance, jurídico, digital. Ser o elo de ligação entre o Distribuidor e a Hy Cite.
  6. Garantir que estratégias de incentivos, eventos, promoções de vendas e lançamentos de novos produtos sejam implementados e executados conforme orientação da Hy Cite.
  7. Compreender e aderir aos padrões legais/de conformidade incluídos nas políticas corporativas e assumir responsabilidade pelas tarefas que atendem aos requisitos legais/de conformidade. Reportar violações de conformidade quando identificadas.

Requisitos:

  • FORMAÇÃO: Graduação completa em instituição reconhecida.
  • HABILIDADES E CONHECIMENTOS:
  • Experiência comprovada em vendas e gestão de equipes, com forte atuação em vendas diretas. Experiência prévia em marketing multinível é altamente desejável.
  • Capacidade demonstrada de trabalhar colaborativamente em equipes, com forte orientação de serviço tanto para stakeholders internos quanto para parceiros externos como Distribuidores.
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade para engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Capacidade de desenvolver planos estratégicos e apresentações de forma independente.
  • Forte habilidade de autogestão e priorização, com capacidade de lidar com tarefas, iniciativas e projetos com supervisão mínima, inclusive em ambientes de trabalho remoto.
  • Perfil analítico e proficiência na gestão de dados de vendas, com experiência prática (preferencial) em Excel e ferramentas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Tableau, entre outras.
  • Orientação para resultados e execução, com atitude proativa, compromisso com a excelência e abertura para aprender sobre o negócio.
  • Fortes habilidades de negociação e construção de relacionamentos, com capacidade de influenciar stakeholders internos e parceiros externos (Distribuidores).
  • Espanhol é desejável.
  • O cargo é remoto. Requer 50% ou mais de viagens para atividades em campo e visitas a escritórios de Distribuidores.

title: Tradutor
description:
Sobre a NARI Brasil

A NARI Brasil é uma empresa integrante ao NARI Group Corporation, líder no fornecimento de equipamentos para o setor de energia elétrica na China. Fundado em 1973, o grupo NARI dedica-se a oferecer tecnologias de ponta.

Desde sua fundação no Brasil em 2013 com suas operações em Sorocaba-SP, a NARI Brasil tem se destacado no desenvolvimento e comercialização de sistemas de controle e proteção de subestações, com foco em soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade.

Oportunidade

Tradutor(a) | Mandarim - Português

Buscamos um profissional para atuar como elo de comunicação entre equipes chinesas e brasileiras, facilitando a integração linguística e cultural nas atividades operacionais, administrativas e estratégicas da empresa. A posição requer alto nível de fluência em chinês mandarim e português brasileiro, além de sensibilidade intercultural para lidar com ambientes corporativos bilíngues e multiculturais.

Se você possui experiência na área e está em busca de desafios, essa oportunidade pode ser interessante para você!

Requisitos

• Superior preferencialmente em Letras, Tradução, Relações Internacionais ou áreas afins;

• Fluência comprovada em Chinês/Mandarim, com excelentes habilidades de compreensão auditiva, conversação, leitura e escrita;

• Fluência em português brasileiro, com excelente comunicação verbal e escrita.

• Ter fortes habilidades de comunicação intercultural, trabalhar de forma meticulosa e consciente e ser capaz de se adaptar a um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico.

Diferenciais:

• Domínio de espanhol e/ou inglês;

• Familiaridade com a cultura e o ambiente de negócios brasileiros.

Descrição das Atividades

• Servir como ponto de contato bilíngue entre a matriz Chinesa e o escritório local, fornecedores e parceiros comerciais, garantindo a fluidez na comunicação e o alinhamento cultural.

• Realizar traduções precisas (oral e escrita) entre chinês mandarim e português, em reuniões, documentos, e comunicações internas e externas;

• Atuar como facilitador no andamento de projetos corporativos

• Auxiliar na mediação entre as equipes chinesas e brasileiras, promovendo entendimento mútuo e facilitando a colaboração;

• Participar de negociações, treinamentos, visitas técnicas e eventos institucionais, assegurando que todas as partes compreendam as informações com clareza.

title: Sales Operations & Data Analyst
description:
Nossa organização de Operações de Vendas é responsável por construir a melhor estratégia de entrada no mercado para conectar nossas soluções às necessidades dos clientes em escala. Como Analista de Estratégia e Operações de Vendas, você trabalhará em parceria com seus colegas para resolver os tópicos estratégicos mais importantes da organização de vendas, impulsionando o crescimento da receita, melhorando a produtividade das vendas e agregando valor aos clientes.

O analista deve ser altamente adaptável, possuir fortes habilidades de comunicação e ter um histórico comprovado de entrega de análises sem erros em cargos anteriores. O candidato também deve ser capaz de lidar com informações sensíveis, confidenciais e não rotineiras, estar aberto a questionar o status quo e trabalhar em uma organização em rápida transformação, ao mesmo tempo em que inspira excelência em si mesmo(a) e nos parceiros de negócios.

Responsabilidades

• Participar de um programa global de transformação de operações

• Contribuir para e comunicar os processos de negócios atuais e futuros, fluxos de dados e diagramas de processos, jornadas dos usuários e fluxos de trabalho

• Criar e manter acompanhamentos de projetos (trackers), bem como canais de comunicação para gerenciar ações de forma eficaz, cumprindo prazos enquanto trabalha em ritmo acelerado

• Avaliar e comunicar regularmente restrições e riscos dos projetos em nível global; identificar dependências, decisões estratégicas, planos de mitigação

• Recomendar soluções para melhorar a produtividade, reduzir a complexidade geral, minimizar dívidas técnicas e possibilitar uma melhor integridade de dados, apoiando pesquisas com usuários (User Research) para aprimorar a experiência do usuário (UX) do produto, atuando como defensor(a) do usuário para as equipes de Operações de Vendas / Vendas

• Estabelecer relacionamentos sólidos de trabalho com colegas de outras equipes de Operações de Vendas e parceiros multifuncionais para alcançar os objetivos

Qualificações Básicas

• Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência em consultoria de gestão, finanças, operações de vendas, operações de negócios ou em funções analíticas/operacionais

• Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência com SFDC (Salesforce) e D365 (Dynamics 365), fluência em SQL, Power BI/Tableau e Excel

Qualificações Desejáveis

• Atenção excepcional aos detalhes: aprendizado ágil com atenção meticulosa aos detalhes e experiência comprovada em identificar pontos de falha em processos

• Experiência com escalabilidade: confortável com dados e incertezas; consegue rapidamente fazer conexões e identificar causas raiz; mergulha nos detalhes e táticas operacionais, ao mesmo tempo em que contribui com a visão estratégica e resolve problemas operacionais

• Experiência com processos e ferramentas de vendas: especialista em fluxos e processos de vendas (ex.: planejamento de headcount, construção de territórios, definição de metas, previsões), operações e ferramentas (ex.: Salesforce, Dynamics 365); experiência na implementação de sistemas de terceiros e uso de metodologias ágeis

• Comunicação clara e eficaz: traduz pensamentos e estratégias complexas em recomendações simples e acionáveis, tanto por escrito quanto verbalmente, em um ambiente dinâmico e orientado por dados — inclusive com apresentações para públicos diversos

• Responsabilidade e priorização: experiência atuando com supervisão limitada no dia a dia, gerenciando múltiplas prioridades e cumprindo prazos

• Proatividade e atitude positiva: busca informações de forma independente, resolve problemas conceituais, mobiliza recursos e entrega resultados em situações desafiadoras e multifacetadas; motivado(a) e engajado(a) para colaborar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante mudança

Habilidades Sugeridas:

• Proficiência técnica em SFDC, D365, SQL, Power BI/Tableau e Excel

• Otimização de processos e resolução de problemas operacionais

• Especialização em operações e fluxos de trabalho de vendas

• Comunicação clara e eficaz

• Adaptabilidade e iniciativa proativa

title: Analista administrativo
description:
Estamos em busca de um Analista Administrativo proativo e eficiente para se juntar ao nosso time.

O candidato deve ter habilidades de escrita e comunicação sólidas, capaz de transmitir informações de forma clara e precisa.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.

Mission

As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
  • Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
  • Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
  • Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
  • Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For

We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.

Key Qualifications:
  • Kubernetes   Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
  • Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
  • Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
  • Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
  • Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g.Bash, Python).
  • Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
  • Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.
Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

title: IT Network Engineer
description:
Responsibilities：

Based on architecture standards set by the headquarters IT architecture team, test and validate local products, drive procurement execution, and complete device purchases.

Collaborate with the headquarters IT architecture team and local service providers to complete the purchases, installation, configuration, and upgrade of network equipment and low-voltage systems (e.g. CCTV, access control systems, racks, and cabling).

Manage local system integration projects to ensure effective implementation of solutions as guided by headquarters' technical requirements, while optimizing execution according to local needs.

Develop and implement localized IT solutions. Ensure IT infrastructure maintenance and operations align with headquarters standards.

Monitor the quality of office network using tools provided by headquarters IT, gather user feedback, and design and implement corresponding improvements.

Track, manage, and Inventory local IT infrastructure resources (including equipment inventories and supplier collaboration) and resolve local application and service issues, and ensure the integrity of IT infrastructure.

Coordinate local service provider resources to ensure rapid problem resolution and efficient use of personnel, equipment, and time to meet project needs effectively.

Provide standard operating procedures and documentation support, regularly reporting progress on localized solutions to headquarters.

Requirements：

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, IT-related fields, or Engineering.

At least 3 years of experience in IT network and data center system integration maintenance.

Familiarity with enterprise-level network architecture and equipment management. Knowledge of routing protocols such as Static Routing, OSPF, and BGP; VPN technologies including GRE, SSL VPN, and IPSec VPN; and wireless authentication protocols like EAP, PEAP, and TLS.

Proficiency in network and system monitoring tools (e.g. Zabbix, Grafana) and experience in operations automation tools.

Experience in managing CCTV, access control systems, facial recognition devices, and UPS systems is preferred.

Familiarity with key brands of switches, wireless APs, cameras, access control systems, racks and cables, with knowledge of their strengths and weaknesses.

Proven experience in developing and implementing IT solutions, with the ability to optimize execution based on practical requirements.

Strong communication and collaboration skills to effectively work with suppliers and headquarters IT teams.

Fluency in both Chinese and English, or Arabic and English, for effective communication is preferred.

Possession of relevant technical certifications (e.g. CCIE) or project management certifications (e.g. PMP) is an advantage.

The Data Migration Specialist is responsible for transitioning and transforming data from legacy systems to new platforms. The specialist will ensure data integrity, security, and accessibility throughout the migration process, thus supporting the organization's strategic initiatives and operational efficiency. The professional will proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a smooth and successful transition with minimal disruption to business operations.

As the first and only online gambling affiliate publicly traded in the U.S., Gambling.com Group has earned recognition as a leader in its field – most recently winning Casino Affiliate of the Year at the 2024 EGR Operator Awards. Gambling.com Group embraces a majority remote-first hybrid work model, offering employees the flexibility to work remotely while being part of a global team. For some roles, in-office presence is required for operational reasons, ensuring seamless collaboration and effectiveness where needed. With flagship offices in Dublin, Charlotte, and Malta, and satellite offices in Madison, Helsinki, Serbia, and Costa Rica, we operate on a "think local, act global" mindset. Gambling.com Group is on the lookout for innovative, solution-driven, and fast-paced thinkers to join our growing team.

Are you ready to take the next step in your career?

At OpticOdds, we’re transforming how companies trade and manage risk in the sports betting industry. We provide real-time sports betting data and risk management solutions that help clients boost profitability while saving thousands of engineering hours. We’ve simplified real-time data and made it more accessible and actionable for sportsbooks, exchanges, and platforms.

Our product is strong. Our traction is real. Now, we’re looking to expand our small, fast-moving team to keep up with explosive growth. That’s where you come in.

As our first Central America Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving OpticOdds’ commercial growth across the region. The focus is on building new business opportunities, developing strategic operator relationships, and expanding accounts over time.

This role requires ownership of the full sales cycle: identifying opportunities, engaging with clients, managing negotiations, and ensuring long-term success with signed operators. Success will come from strong industry connections, sharp commercial instincts, and the ability to represent OpticOdds effectively both at industry events and in direct client engagements.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the full sales cycle with clients, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Develop a balanced pipeline by sourcing outbound opportunities and converting inbound leads.
  • Expand OpticOdds’ footprint across Central and South America with a focus on enterprise sportsbooks while also engaging emerging operators.
  • Deliver clear, compelling presentations to clients at all levels of an organization, both in-person and remotely.
  • Listen actively to client needs and translate those into actionable feedback for the product and engineering teams.
  • Monitor regulatory changes, competitor activity, and operator strategies, and use those insights to strengthen OpticOdds’ positioning.
  • Represent OpticOdds at industry events and conferences to build visibility and credibility in the region.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data in the CRM with clear prioritization and forecasting.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to refine messaging, improve collateral, and align commercial strategy with product direction.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience in the sports betting industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed aggressive revenue targets.
  • Strong network within sportsbooks and operators in Central and South America.
  • Fluency in Spanish and Portuguese strongly preferred.
  • Experience running a SaaS sales process independently, from prospecting through closing.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with credibility in conversations with senior operator stakeholders.
  • Proficient with CRMs and confident in building and presenting proposals.
  • Self-starter who thrives in high-growth, unstructured environments.

Perks & Benefits

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Comprehensive private Healthcare Insurance
  • Flexible work environment with the option for remote work
  • Lifestyle Allowance/Lifestyle Spending Account
  • Hardware and software
  • Regular company events, including seasonal parties and sports & social outings.
  • Access to courses for Personal and Career Development
  • Company Paid Volunteer Day

title: Gerente de Vendas | Caminhões Sanitários
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração.

Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto.

Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países. No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m². Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa. E

m 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril. No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá:

  • Desenvolver e implementar o plano estratégico de vendas para o portfólio de Caminhões Sanitários;
  • Gerenciar o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos, assegurando a satisfação do cliente;
  • Identificar oportunidades de mercado e novas demandas, analisando concorrência, tendências e potencial de clientes;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos com stakeholders do setor;
  • Realizar visitas técnicas e comerciais, apresentações de produtos e negociação de propostas comerciais;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de engenharia, pós-vendas e operações para garantir soluções técnicas adequadas e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da área comercial (KPIs), como volume de vendas, margem, rentabilidade e forecast;
  • Participar de feiras, eventos e fóruns do setor portuário e logístico para promover a marca e gerar novos negócios.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas técnicas, preferencialmente no setor de Caminhões Sanitários;
  • Atuação prévia com negociações complexas (grandes contas, projetos sob medida, contratos de longo prazo);
  • Vivência no relacionamento com clientes B2B e na gestão de ciclo de vendas consultivo;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM e pacote Office.

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Refeição no Local
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

title: Tax Sr Analyst (Advanced English)
description:
Join Our Team as Tax Sr Analyst – Brazil (São Paulo) Advanced English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Department: Finance LATAM

Reports to: Senior Tax Manager LATAM

Are you a seasoned tax professional ready to lead and make an impact in a global organization? We’re looking for a Tax Sr Analyst to oversee tax compliance and strategic initiatives for our Brazilian entity. This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your expertise will shape tax operations and support business growth.

What You’ll Do

As Tax Sr Analyst, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading tax compliance for direct and indirect taxes in Brazil.
  • Preparing tax calculations for review by external advisors (EY, Deloitte).
  • Managing deferred tax accounting (IFRS and BRGAAP), including annual and half-year calculations.
  • Overseeing reconciliations for tax GL accounts using SAP and Blackline.
  • Coordinating SPED, municipal obligations (withholding tax), IBGE, and BACEN reporting.
  • Supporting Transfer Pricing processes with external specialists.
  • Advising internal teams on tax treatment for various operations.
  • Staying ahead of regulatory changes, including Brazil’s ongoing Tax Reform.
  • Collaborating with external auditors and tax authorities during audits.
  • Leading a team of 3 direct reports and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Minimum 6 years in Brazilian tax (local & international), tax accounting, and compliance.
  • Education: Degree in Accounting or Tax.
  • Technical Skills: SAP, SPED, HFM (BRACS), Blackline.
  • Tax Expertise: IRPJ, CSLL, ISS, PIS, COFINS, ICMS; knowledge of tax treaties and audit processes.
  • Languages: Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, analytical mindset, team leadership, and collaboration.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a global company with a strong presence in LATAM.
  • Lead impactful tax projects and contribute to strategic decisions.
  • Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for development and innovation.
